strings.f21c1e3e-56df-4d8c-845e-658bec53fecc: When you use Combat Expertise, reduce the penalty on melee attack rolls and combat maneuvers by 2. Prerequisites: Intelligence 13, base attack bonus +8, and Combat Expertise.
strings.12e5f12d-29bc-445c-9305-d76930dc91ca: Reduce the arcane spell failure chance from your shield by 15 percentage points, to a minimum of 0. This does not reduce spell failure from body armor. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.PsychicClass.name: Psychic (Casting Prototype)
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.PsychicClass.descript: An experimental psychic caster with Intelligence-based spontaneous spells through 9th level, a d6 Hit Die and 2 skill points. Spells use thought and emotion components. Includes 17 exclusive spells, undercasting, the complete Ferocity discipline, three basic phrenic amplifications and a private spell list with optional provider integration. The other five CotW disciplines, later amplifications, remaining spells and mythic merging are not yet included. New content still requires in-game testing.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.PsychicSpellbook.name: Psychic
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.PsychicSpellcasting.d: Psychic spells require thought and emotion components. Concentration checks take a -10 penalty unless Center Self is active. Active fear, shaken, frightened or negative-emotion effects prevent psychic spellcasting unless Logical Spell removes the emotion component. Logical Spell does not remove incapacity or other casting restrictions. Psychic spells do not suffer armor or shield arcane spell failure and can be cast while polymorphed. Items and other classes' spellbooks retain their normal restrictions.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.CenterSelf.name: Center Self
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.CenterSelf.descriptio: Spend a move action to center yourself. For 1 round, your psychic spells use normal concentration checks instead of taking the -10 thought-component penalty. This does not remove emotion components.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.CenterSelfBuff.name: Centered
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.CenterSelfBuff.descri: Your psychic spells use normal concentration checks for 1 round.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.LogicalSpell.name: Metamagic (Logical Spell)
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.LogicalSpell.descript: Remove the emotion component of a psychic spell, allowing it to be cast under fear, shaken or negative-emotion effects that would otherwise block psychic magic. Thought components and their concentration penalty still apply. This does not let an incapacitated character act. A logical spell uses a spell slot one level higher than normal. Applies only to this prototype's psychic spellbook.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.PhrenicAbilitySelecti: Choose Wisdom or Charisma for the phrenic pool foundation. This is a casting prototype choice, not a complete psychic discipline. Disciplines and amplifications remain in development.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.WisdomPhrenicPool.des: Your phrenic pool capacity is half your Psychic level, rounded down, plus your permanent Wisdom modifier, to a minimum of 0. It is restored by rest. Ferocity uses this pool for Enhanced Senses; selected phrenic amplifications share the same points.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.CharismaPhrenicPool.d: Legacy casting-prototype pool. Capacity is half your Psychic level, rounded down, plus your permanent Charisma modifier, to a minimum of 0. No Charisma discipline is selectable in this build.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust1.name: Mind Thrust I
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust1.desc: Overload an intelligent creature's mind, dealing 1d6 direct damage per caster level (maximum 5 dice). Will halves the damage.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust2.name: Mind Thrust II
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust2.desc: Overload an intelligent creature's mind, dealing 1d8 direct damage per caster level (maximum 5 dice). Will halves the damage. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust3.name: Mind Thrust III
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust3.desc: Overload an intelligent creature's mind, dealing 1d8 direct damage per caster level (maximum 10 dice). Will halves the damage. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust4.name: Mind Thrust IV
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust4.desc: Overload an intelligent creature's mind, dealing 1d8 direct damage per caster level (maximum 15 dice). Will halves the damage. A failed save also causes fatigue for 1 round. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust5.name: Mind Thrust V
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust5.desc: Overload an intelligent creature's mind, dealing 1d8 direct damage per caster level (maximum 15 dice). Will halves the damage. A failed save also causes exhaustion for 1 round. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust6.name: Mind Thrust VI
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.MindThrust6.desc: Overload an intelligent creature's mind, dealing 1d8 direct damage per caster level (maximum 20 dice). Will halves the damage. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ForceSwordWeapon: Create a longsword of pure force in the target's empty primary hand for 1 minute per caster level. It deals normal longsword damage as force damage, using normal weapon attacks and proficiency. Its enhancement bonus is +1, increasing to +2 at caster level 8 and +3 at caster level 13. The hand is reserved while the sword exists; the sword vanishes when the effect ends. It cannot be sold or kept as a permanent item.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PsychicSurgery.d: Restore all Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma damage and drain. Remove ongoing fear and confusion effects. Also remove harmful mind-affecting or enchantment effects: dispellable spell effects of any spell level, or other effects of spell level 6 or lower. Beneficial mental effects, physical ability damage, and effects without a removable ongoing buff are unaffected. Requires the same diamond dust component as Stoneskin.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FaithCure1.name: Divine Energy: Cure Light Wounds
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FaithCure1.descr:
Convert a Psychic spell slot into a cure or inflict spell of the same level, using the conversion arrow under a known spell. Choose healing or wounding as permitted by your alignment and deity. Each conversion spends one daily use and its original spell slot. A successful conversion restores 1 phrenic point, up to your pool's maximum. Uses per day equal your Wisdom modifier (minimum 0). Converted spells are psychic spells, but are not added to your spells known or class spell list.

Functions as Cure Light Wounds. Positive energy heals living creatures and harms undead. Undead can make a Will save for half damage.

As a free action, project a 30-foot prayer aura for a total number of rounds per day equal to your psychic level. Allies (including you) gain a +1 luck bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage, saving throws and skill checks. Enemies take a -1 penalty to those rolls, or -2 if they oppose you on either the good/evil or lawful/chaotic axis. Opposing both axes still gives only -2. Turning the aura off removes its effects immediately; combat ending, unconsciousness or disability also ends it.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PsychicCrush1.de: Crush a creature's mind. A successful Will save sickens the target for 1 round. A failed Will save requires a Fortitude save: success deals 3d6 direct damage plus your caster level and sickens the target for 1 round; failure reduces it to -1 HP. Damage from this spell cannot reduce HP below -1. The Fortitude save gains a +4 circumstance bonus if the target has more than half its maximum HP. Temporary HP does not affect these thresholds. Mind-affecting immunity and spell resistance apply. As in CotW, constructs and vermin cannot be targeted.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PsychicCrush2.de: Crush a creature's mind. A successful Will save sickens the target for 1 round. A failed Will save requires a Fortitude save: success deals 5d6 direct damage plus your caster level and sickens the target for 1 round; failure reduces it to -1 HP. Damage from this spell cannot reduce HP below -1. The Fortitude save gains a +4 circumstance bonus at full HP, or +2 above half HP. Temporary HP does not affect these thresholds. Mind-affecting immunity and spell resistance apply. As in CotW, constructs and vermin cannot be targeted. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PsychicCrush3.de: Crush a creature's mind. A successful Will save deals 1 direct damage per caster level and sickens the target for 1 round. A failed Will save requires a Fortitude save: success deals 7d6 direct damage plus your caster level and sickens the target for 1 round; failure reduces it to -1 HP. Damage from this spell cannot reduce HP below -1. The Fortitude save gains a +2 circumstance bonus at full HP. Temporary HP does not affect these thresholds. Mind-affecting immunity and spell resistance apply. As in CotW, constructs and vermin cannot be targeted. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PsychicCrush4.de: Crush a creature's mind. A successful Will save deals 9d6 direct damage plus your caster level and sickens the target for 1 round. A failed Will save requires a Fortitude save: success deals 9d6 direct damage plus your caster level and sickens the target for 1 round; failure reduces it to -1 HP. Damage from this spell cannot reduce HP below -1. If the target has less than half its maximum HP, a failed Will save skips the Fortitude save and reduces it to -1 HP. Exactly half HP still allows Fortitude. Temporary HP does not affect these thresholds. Mind-affecting immunity and spell resistance apply. As in CotW, constructs and vermin cannot be targeted. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PsychicCrush5.de: Crush a creature's mind. A successful Will save deals 11d6 direct damage plus your caster level and sickens the target for 1 round. A failed Will save requires a Fortitude save: success deals 11d6 direct damage plus your caster level and sickens the target for 1 round; failure reduces it to -1 HP. Damage from this spell cannot reduce HP below -1. If the target has less than half its maximum HP, a failed Will save skips the Fortitude save and reduces it to -1 HP. Exactly half HP still allows Fortitude. Below half HP, the Will save also takes a -2 penalty. Temporary HP does not affect these thresholds. Mind-affecting immunity and spell resistance apply. As in CotW, constructs and vermin cannot be targeted. This spell can be undercast.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SilenceBuff.name: Silence
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SilenceBuff.desc: Create a stationary 20-foot-radius area of silence for 1 round per caster level. Creatures inside cannot cast spells requiring speech; psychic spellcasting is unaffected. The area grants immunity to sonic damage and sonic spell effects and suppresses sonic buffs and Echolocation. Leaving the area immediately ends its effects. Because the spell is centered on a point in space, there is no saving throw or spell resistance. The area remains at its chosen point and does not move with a creature.

On success, the ally gains a +4 bonus on their next check with that skill and you regain 1 phrenic point, up to your maximum. The bonus ends after that check or on resting. Uses per day equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 0); failed attempts also spend a use.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PageantryDiscipl: Elaborate rituals unlock your psychic power. Gain Ritual Unity, Power from Pageantry, Unrivaled Focus and nine bonus spells. Your phrenic pool is half your psychic level plus your Charisma modifier. Uses the Call of the Wild adaptation of this discipline.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DivideMindBuff.d: For 1 minute, roll twice and take the higher result on Will saves, Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks. Your secondary mind can cast Psychic spells and use spell-like abilities of 5th level or lower as swift actions, without increasing their spell slots or costs. Only abilities with a standard or move casting action qualify; full-round casting and item abilities do not. The normal swift-action limit applies. Other kinds of purely mental actions are not automated.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DivideMind.name: Divide Mind
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DivideMind.descr: For 1 minute, roll twice and take the higher result on Will saves, Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks. Your secondary mind can cast Psychic spells and use spell-like abilities of 5th level or lower as swift actions, without increasing their spell slots or costs. Only abilities with a standard or move casting action qualify; full-round casting and item abilities do not. The normal swift-action limit applies. Other kinds of purely mental actions are not automated.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.LocateWeaknessBu: For 1 minute per caster level, your confirmed weapon critical hits deal maximum weapon dice damage. Extra damage dice, such as sneak attack and flaming weapon damage, are not maximized. This follows the Call of the Wild adaptation of Locate Weakness.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.LocateWeakness.d: For 1 minute per caster level, your confirmed weapon critical hits deal maximum weapon dice damage. Extra damage dice, such as sneak attack and flaming weapon damage, are not maximized. This follows the Call of the Wild adaptation of Locate Weakness.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.InvigorateBuff.d: Temporarily suppress fatigue and exhaustion for 10 minutes per caster level. This does not provide rest or restore any resources. When the spell ends, any remaining fatigue and exhaustion resume. Multiple castings replace the previous effect. The spell causes no damage when it ends.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.Invigorate.name: Invigorate
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.Invigorate.descr: Temporarily suppress fatigue and exhaustion for 10 minutes per caster level. This does not provide rest or restore any resources. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.InvigorateMass.d: Affects you and allies within 15 feet. Temporarily suppress fatigue and exhaustion for 10 minutes per caster level. This does not provide rest or restore any resources. When the spell ends, any remaining fatigue and exhaustion resume. Multiple castings replace the previous effect. The spell causes no damage when it ends.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HowlingAgonyBuff: Enemies in a 30-foot burst within close range suffer wracking pain for 1 round per caster level. They take a -2 penalty to AC, attack rolls, melee weapon damage and Reflex saves. Casting a spell requires a concentration check (DC 15 + spell level). Fortitude negates; spell resistance applies. The pain cannot be relieved by spending an action to scream.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HowlingAgony.des: Enemies in a 30-foot burst within close range suffer wracking pain for 1 round per caster level. The pain cannot be relieved by spending an action to scream.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HaltUndeadBuff.d: Undead enemies in a 10-foot burst within medium range are held immobile for 1 round per caster level. Will negates; spell resistance applies. A held creature receives another Will save each round. Attacking it or dealing damage ends the effect. This follows the Call of the Wild area adaptation, rather than selecting three individual targets.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HaltUndead.name: Halt Undead
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HaltUndead.descr: Undead enemies in a 10-foot burst within medium range are held immobile for 1 round per caster level. Will negates; spell resistance applies. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ControlUndeadBuf: Control one nonsummoned undead creature within close range for 1 minute per caster level. Will negates; spell resistance applies. The creature fights for your side under the normal domination AI, and returns to its original allegiance when the effect ends. This is not a mind-affecting effect. This follows the Call of the Wild single-target adaptation.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ControlUndead.de: Control one nonsummoned undead creature within close range for 1 minute per caster level. Will negates; spell resistance applies. The creature fights for your side under the normal domination AI, and returns to its original allegiance when the effect ends. This is not a mind-affecting effect. This follows the Call of the Wild single-target adaptation.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.WardingWeaponBuf: A spectral weapon guards your spellcasting for 1 round per caster level. You can cast spells and spell-like abilities without provoking attacks of opportunity for casting and without a defensive casting check. This does not protect movement, ranged attacks, or other provoking actions, and does not waive concentration checks caused by damage or other interference. The weapon does not attack or deal damage.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.WardingWeapon.de: A spectral weapon guards your spellcasting for 1 round per caster level. You can cast spells and spell-like abilities without provoking attacks of opportunity for casting and without a defensive casting check. This does not protect movement, ranged attacks, or other provoking actions, and does not waive concentration checks caused by damage or other interference. The weapon does not attack or deal damage.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DazeMassBuff.des: Daze humanoid enemies in a 15-foot burst within close range for 1 round, with no Hit Dice limit. Will negates; spell resistance applies. Dazed creatures cannot act. This follows Call of the Wild's creature-type filtering: aberrations, constructs, dragons, fey, outsiders, and plants are excluded. Animals, magical beasts, monstrous humanoids, and vermin require the caster's Serpentine bloodline arcana. Normal mind-affecting and daze immunities still apply.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DazeMass.name: Daze, Mass
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DazeMass.descrip: Daze humanoid enemies in a 15-foot burst within close range for 1 round, with no Hit Dice limit. Will negates; spell resistance applies. Dazed creatures cannot act. This follows Call of the Wild's creature-type filtering: aberrations, constructs, dragons, fey, outsiders, and plants are excluded. Animals, magical beasts, monstrous humanoids, and vermin require the caster's Serpentine bloodline arcana. Normal mind-affecting and daze immunities still apply.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SavageMawBuff.de: Gain a secondary bite attack dealing 1d4 damage (Medium), using the normal natural-attack Strength and size rules, for 1 minute per caster level. While this spell lasts, confirmed critical hits with bite attacks cause 1d4 bleed damage each round. Healing ends the bleed. As a swift action, you can end the spell with Savage Maw: Roar, attempting an Intimidate check to demoralize enemies within 30 feet. The roar follows the native Dazzling Display demoralize rules, without its weapon or feat requirement.

For 1 minute per caster level, each damage event that deals at least 5 points of piercing or slashing damage to you gives your worn armor a +1 enhancement bonus, to a maximum of +5. Removing your armor suspends the armor bonus; another suit you equip receives your accumulated enhancement. Recasting resets the accumulated bonus.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.GlobeOfInvulnera: Create a stationary 13-foot-radius globe centered on your current position for 1 round per caster level. Creatures inside are protected from newly applied spells and spell-like abilities of level 3 or lower, including cantrips and spells from items. This blocks helpful as well as harmful effects, regardless of spell resistance. Spells can be cast out of or through the globe and affect creatures outside normally. Higher-level spells and supernatural abilities are unaffected. Heighten Spell changes the spell level used for this protection; other metamagic does not. Existing buffs and areas created before the globe are not removed or suppressed. Area dispelling can remove the globe. The globe stays behind if you move; leaving ends its protection, and returning restores it. Uses Call of the Wild's 13-foot area adaptation.

Extract the air from living creatures that must breathe. Fortitude success causes only 1 round of staggered. On failure, the subject is staggered and begins to suffocate. Starting on its next round, a failed Fortitude save advances one step: reduce hit points to 0, then to -1, then death. Successful later saves delay progression without ending the spell. The single-target spell lasts 3 rounds; the mass spell affects enemies in a 30-foot burst for 1 round per caster level. Undead, constructs and elementals are excluded. This is a death effect.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ControlConstruct: Control one construct within close range for 1 round per caster level. Each round, the caster must succeed at a Knowledge (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the construct's Hit Dice or control ends. Only one construct can be controlled by this spell per caster. The construct uses normal domination AI and its original allegiance returns when control ends. As in Call of the Wild, maintenance uses the automatic skill check rather than a separate concentration action. This is not mind-affecting; no saving throw or spell resistance applies.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ScouringWindsFog: Create a movable 20-foot-radius sandstorm within medium range for 1 round per caster level. On entry and each round, creatures take 3d6 piercing damage (at most once per creature per round). Medium or smaller creatures must pass a DC10 Strength check to move; Small or smaller creatures also need DC15 Strength or fall prone and take2d6 bludgeoning damage. Air-subtype creatures ignore movement/visibility effects, but still take sand damage. The storm grants total fog concealment, blocks sight-based effects, slows movement, and prevents ordinary ranged weapon attacks into or out of it; rays are not automatically blocked. Move it with a move action, retaining remaining duration and original casting parameters. Repositioning does not sweep the path. No save or spell resistance applies; allies can be affected.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.BabbleFascinated: One creature within medium range must succeed at a Will save or babble uncontrollably and become nauseated for 1 round per caster level. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FieryShurikenRes: Create two fiery shuriken plus one per two caster levels beyond 3rd, maximum eight at caster level 15. Each projectile makes its own ranged touch attack for 1d8 fire damage; spell resistance applies and there is no save. Choose to launch all at one target immediately, or launch one and retain the rest for 1 round per caster level. Later, launch one as a swift action, or two to seven as a standard action. Launching retained shuriken does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Recasting replaces any retained shuriken. This follows Call of the Wild's initial one/all selection.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.OrbOfTheVoidCont: Create a 2-foot-radius sphere of negative energy within close range for 1 round per caster level. It affects the first creature entering or occupying its space each round: living creatures gain one temporary negative level for 24 hours, Fortitude negates; undead gain 2d4 times 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour. Spell resistance applies. As a move action, reposition the sphere while it has not affected a creature this round. Movement retains the original casting parameters and remaining duration. Temporary hit points from repeated applications do not stack. Consumes two diamond dust.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HexVulnerability: On a failed Will save, the target becomes susceptible to repeated uses of your harmful witch and shaman hexes for 1 round per caster level. This bypasses only their per-target cooldown, not creature-type restrictions or immunities. Other casters receive no benefit. Existing hex effects and cooldowns are not removed. Each subsequent casting on the same target within 24 hours grants it a cumulative +4 bonus on its save against this spell, even if the previous save succeeded.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FireSeedsResourc: Create fire seeds for 10 minutes per caster level. The recipient gains a pool of fire dice equal to caster level, maximum 20. Choose 1 to 10 dice per standard-action throw, spending that many dice. A ranged touch hit deals that many d4 fire damage, plus 1 fire damage per die to all creatures within 5 feet, including the primary target. A miss deals only splash damage. No save; spell resistance does not apply. This follows Call of the Wild's acorn-grenade implementation. Recasting replaces the remaining pool; the abilities disappear when the spell ends.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SanctuaryBuff.de: Opponents must succeed at a Will save to directly attack the warded creature. Each opponent's result is remembered for this casting, including after saving and loading. Failed attackers cannot directly attack it until this ward ends. Area effects are unaffected. Making an offensive action ends your ward. Lasts 1 round per caster level. The command target check rejects prohibited attacks; it does not impose an additional action cost.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.BattlemindLinkBu: Link your thoughts with one ally for 1 minute per caster level. Both gain +2 initiative. After one partner attempts a melee or ranged attack against an enemy, the other gains +2 on attacks of the same kind against that enemy for 1 round. After one partner targets an enemy with a spell, that enemy takes -2 on saves against the other partner's spells for 1 round. This follows Call of the Wild's coordinated-attack implementation. A creature can have only one link; replacing or ending either half ends the pair.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.RejuvenateEidolo: Touch your eidolon to heal 1d10 + 1 hit point per caster level (maximum +5). Only your own Making Friends eidolon is a legal target. This optional integration adds the spell to that mod's summoner spell list when available; ordinary animal companions are not eidolons.

Touch your eidolon to heal 3d10 + 1 hit point per caster level (maximum +10). Only your own Making Friends eidolon is a legal target. This optional integration adds the spell to that mod's summoner spell list when available; ordinary animal companions are not eidolons.

Touch your eidolon to heal 5d10 + 1 hit point per caster level (maximum +20). Only your own Making Friends eidolon is a legal target. This optional integration adds the spell to that mod's summoner spell list when available; ordinary animal companions are not eidolons.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SpiritualWeaponU: Create spiritual weapon for 1 round per caster level. It attacks your designated enemy and can be redirected with a move action. Casting allows one attack; redirecting after an attack changes the next attack without granting an extra attack that round. Later rounds allow normal iterative attacks (Mage's Sword and Twilight Knife attack once). Attacks use your base attack bonus and highest mental ability modifier; Mage's Sword instead uses caster level plus that modifier +3. Force damage ignores physical damage reduction and incorporeal resistance. A failed spell resistance check ends this casting. You may dismiss it as a free action. Only one of each kind can be maintained by a caster. Each hit deals 1d8 force damage +1 per 3 caster levels (maximum +5). Choose Chaos (battleaxe), Evil (light flail), Good (warhammer), Law (longsword), or your deity's favored weapon. Critical threat and multiplier follow that weapon. These choices are not restricted by your alignment. If your deity has multiple favored weapons, its first supported native category is used. Retargeting moves it to the target's vicinity. The spell controller schedules attacks at six-second round boundaries; enemy movement does not consume additional caster actions.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ArcaneEyeUnit.de: Create an invisible, directly controllable floating sensor for 1 minute per caster level. It moves at speed 30 and reveals the area around it along walkable paths. Use a party member for object and door interactions. Select the eye alone to move it. It cannot attack or cast spells. Dismissing the spell or replacing your eye removes the sensor and its vision. The sensor follows the game's walkable navigation, not unrestricted three-dimensional flight.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FeralGraceFeat.d: Choose one natural attack category. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DazzlingIntimida: While wielding a weapon for which you have weapon training, add that training bonus to Intimidate checks. Requires fighter level 5 and weapon training.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.AmplifiedHexBuff: Sacrifice any prepared spell or spontaneous spell slot of level 1 to 9 to amplify your next native witch or shaman hex. All three benefits apply together: saving throw DC +slot level, finite effect duration +slot level rounds (if originally at least 1 round), and range +10 feet for levels 1-3, +20 feet for 4-6, or +30 feet for 7-9 (if originally at least 30 feet). Personal/touch range, instantaneous/permanent effects and target cooldowns are unchanged. This is an empowered variant of the tabletop feat. There is no increasing slot-level requirement or daily use cap. Use the spell conversion menu; the sacrificed spell is not cast. Only one hex can be armed. Other spells and abilities do not consume it. Requires a learned supported hex.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.RageCasting1Buff: As a swift action, arm your next bloodrager spell for 1 round. Choose 1 to 4 damage dice; the actual number is capped by that spell's slot level. Gain that many points of saving throw DC and lose that many d6 hit points when the spell is attempted. This loss bypasses temporary hit points, resistances and damage reduction and cannot be reduced by damage modifiers. Items, cantrips and spells from other classes do not trigger it. Only one choice can be armed. Requires bloodrager level 4. A native failed spell that still spends its slot also pays this cost; canceled commands and forced failures do not.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.WeaponOfChosenBu:
As a swift action, bless your deity's favored weapon for 1 round. Your next attack with a favored weapon counts as magical for damage reduction and striking incorporeal creatures, and can reroll one failed concealment check. This does not grant an attack or damage bonus or ghost touch. Requires Weapon Focus in a favored category and the ability to cast 1st-level divine spells. Favored categories follow the deity's native starting weapons; deity and weapon blueprints are not modified.
Weapon of the Chosen now affects all favored-weapon attacks until the start of your next turn (1 round in real time). Open the single persistent property selector to select one alignment component belonging to your deity for overcoming damage reduction. Selecting another property directly replaces the active property; only one remains active. The five choices are suboptions of one Sacred Weapon-style menu, not separate entries. A wholly neutral deity instead grants both cold iron and silver. The deity's alignment, not your personal alignment, controls availability. Choose before blessing; changing it affects the next blessing. The default is the first available choice. Your weapon retains its original damage type; other weapons and spell damage receive no benefit.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SpiritualWeaponF: Create spiritual weapon for 1 round per caster level. It attacks your designated enemy and can be redirected with a move action. Casting allows one attack; redirecting after an attack changes the next attack without granting an extra attack that round. Later rounds allow normal iterative attacks (Mage's Sword and Twilight Knife attack once). Attacks use your base attack bonus and highest mental ability modifier; Mage's Sword instead uses caster level plus that modifier +3. Force damage ignores physical damage reduction and incorporeal resistance. A failed spell resistance check ends this casting. You may dismiss it as a free action. Only one of each kind can be maintained by a caster. Each hit deals 1d8 force damage +1 per 3 caster levels (maximum +5). Choose Chaos (battleaxe), Evil (light flail), Good (warhammer), Law (longsword), or your deity's favored weapon. Critical threat and multiplier follow that weapon. These choices are not restricted by your alignment. If your deity has multiple favored weapons, its first supported native category is used. Retargeting moves it to the target's vicinity. The spell controller schedules attacks at six-second round boundaries; enemy movement does not consume additional caster actions.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PlanarCelestialT: When using druid wild shape to take an animal form or an eligible shifter major form, you may spend one additional wild shape use to gain the celestial or fiendish template for that form. Good characters may choose only celestial; evil characters only fiendish; neutral characters may choose either. Select the persistent template before transforming. Animal forms gain the native template's spell resistance, energy resistances, damage reduction and daily smite, scaled to your own Hit Dice. Natural-weapon critical confirmation rolls gain +2 against the opposite alignment. Elemental and plant forms do not spend the extra use or gain the template. Master Shapeshifter and native unlimited-major-form features waive all wild-shape cost, including the extra use. Rageshaper Devastating Form and Fiendflesh Shifter Fiendish Aspect are excluded. Requires wild shape and Lore (Religion) 5 ranks.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PowerfulShapeFea: During druid or eligible shifter wild shape, treat your size as one category larger for combat maneuver size bonuses to CMB and CMD. This does not change your model, reach, AC, attack bonus or damage dice. At the engine's maximum size no further size bonus is gained. Treat size as one category larger for native grab/trample target-size eligibility, including incoming special attacks. Grab uses the existing CMB/CMD bonuses; its native +4 bonus is not duplicated. Trample uses the native overrun/damage implementation. Size alone does not increase Strength, HD or any saving throw DC. Requires wild shape and druid or shifter level 8; Devastating Form and Fiendish Aspect are excluded.
During druid or eligible shifter wild shape, your natural weapons gain the physical damage form and material properties of the proficient melee weapon melded from your original primary hand. Trip weapons grant +2 to trip checks; disarm weapons grant +2 to disarm checks, following the CotW weapon-property list. Damage dice, critical range and multiplier, reach, double/fragile properties and attack count remain those of your form. Magical special abilities and enhancement bonuses require the later feats. Requires wild shape.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ImprovedWeaponSh: Weapon Shift also transfers the melded melee weapon instance's current magical special abilities and enhancement bonuses, including permanent additions and temporary spell enchantments. Changes to the original weapon synchronize with your natural weapons. Enhancement bonuses use the native stacking rules; a stronger existing non-stacking bonus remains stronger. Dancing and ranged/thrown-only properties do not transfer. Requires Weapon Shift, wild shape and base attack bonus +6.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.GreaterWeaponShi: Legacy saved feat retained for compatibility. Its enchantment and enhancement transfer is now included in Improved Weapon Shift at BAB +6. Existing saved Greater Weapon Shift facts remain valid and grant the same merged transfer without stacking duplicate effects; this legacy feat is no longer offered for new selection.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.TargetOpportunit: When an ally with Target of Opportunity hits an opponent with a ranged weapon attack, you may make one ranged attack against that opponent within 30 feet. Turn on the persistent Allow Reaction toggle to consent to automatic use of this game's swift-action pool (including outside your turn); the expenditure blocks another reaction or swift ability until your pool refreshes. Your primary ranged weapon must be ready, and you must be able to attack the target. Reaction attacks cannot trigger another Target of Opportunity reaction. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.CompanionShareSp: Share Spells (Ex): Your master may cast personal-range spells from the spellcasting class that grants or advances this companion on you as touch spells instead of on themselves. This ability is available from companion level 1 or as soon as the companion is gained. It also applies to native mounts and other supported permanent class companions with a matching source spellbook. Creature-type target restrictions are waived for this sharing; other target restrictions remain. Spell-like abilities, item spells, alchemical extracts and unrelated spellbooks are not shared. Bonded Mind and the Share Spells teamwork feat are not required.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.LinnormStyleMode: Requires Wisdom 13, Improved Unarmed Strike and base attack bonus +3. While using this combat style, take -2 AC against melee attacks (including melee touch attacks). After an enemy makes a melee weapon attack against you, your unarmed strikes against that enemy use your positive Wisdom modifier for damage if it exceeds the current Strength or Dexterity modifier. The opening lasts until the beginning of that enemy's next turn (six seconds in real time). Other damage statistics, weapons and targets are unchanged.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.LinnormVengeance: Requires Wisdom 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, Linnorm Style and base attack bonus +6. While using Linnorm Style, after an enemy hits you with a melee weapon attack, gain +2 on unarmed attack rolls against that enemy until the beginning of its next turn (six seconds in real time). Repeated hits do not stack this bonus.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.LinnormWrathFeat: Requires Wisdom 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, Linnorm Style, Linnorm Vengeance and base attack bonus +9. While using Linnorm Style, an enemy's melee weapon hit lets you retaliate with one unarmed attack of opportunity per round. This requires an unarmed threat hand and normal threat, reach, target legality and remaining native opportunity-attack allowance. The allowance refreshes at the start of your turn (after six seconds in real time). A failed eligibility check does not consume this feat's use. These retaliations cannot trigger another Linnorm retaliation.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ScalesAndSkinFea: Requires Constitution 13. While a transmutation spell or spell-like ability with an ongoing buff affects you, increase your natural armor by +1, or +2 if that effect's caster level is at least 10. Use the highest eligible active effect; multiple effects do not stack this feat's bonus. It stacks with existing natural armor and natural armor enhancement, applies to normal and flat-footed AC, and does not apply to touch AC. It ends immediately when the last qualifying effect ends or is suppressed. Instantaneous effects and supernatural or extraordinary abilities do not qualify.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ViciousStompFeat: Requires Combat Reflexes and Improved Unarmed Strike. When an enemy falls prone adjacent to you, it provokes one unarmed attack of opportunity. This uses the game's successful knockdown event, an unarmed threat hand, adjacency (5 feet), normal target legality and the native opportunity-attack allowance. Remaining prone or standing up does not trigger this feat again. An ordinary stand-up opportunity attack retains its own native rules. Greater Trip and this feat share the native opportunity-attack limits.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.TopplingSpellFea: A toppling spell uses a spell slot one level higher. When a spell with the force descriptor deals damage to a creature, attempt to trip that creature using caster level instead of base attack bonus and the spell's casting ability instead of Strength. A ray must hit, and actual damage must be dealt. Use the game's normal trip immunity and CMD rules. One check per damaged creature per casting; multiple missiles do not repeat the same check. No extra action or attack of opportunity is required.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SpontaneousMetaf: Requires Charisma 13, a metamagic feat and a known spell in a spontaneous spellbook. Choose one spell you can cast spontaneously. Applying metamagic to that spell no longer adds the spontaneous full-round casting delay. The spell's own longer casting time and other effects requiring a full-round action remain. Prepared books, arcanist preparation, item casts, spell level and slot costs are unchanged. You may select this feat again for a different known spontaneous spell.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SwordplayStyleMo: Requires base attack bonus +3, Combat Expertise and Weapon Focus in a supported blade category. While using this style with a supported blade and Fighting Defensively or Combat Expertise, gain a +1 shield bonus to AC (does not stack with other shield bonuses). On your first ordinary melee weapon attack each turn, ignore only the Combat Expertise attack penalty. Later attacks and attacks of opportunity retain it. The first attack is tracked even when the style is off; toggling it does not restore this benefit. Real-time uses a six-second turn window. Total defense is not an available action in this game.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SwordplayStyleTo: Requires base attack bonus +3, Combat Expertise and Weapon Focus in a supported blade category. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SwordplayUpsetFe: Requires base attack bonus +5, Swordplay Style and the game's move-action Feint feat (the native counterpart of Improved Feint). While using Swordplay Style with a supported blade, an enemy missing you with a melee weapon attack permits an immediate feint against that attacker. It uses the current native Feint skill check, target restrictions and effects, including Final Feint and Slayer's Feint if owned. It does not spend another move action or cast the spell version of Feint. Fake preview rolls and ranged attacks do not trigger it.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FeyFoundlingFeat: You can select this feat only at character level 1. Whenever you receive magical healing with dice, heal 2 additional points per healing die. The extra amount is added after Empower and before native healing resistance and the maximum-HP cap; flat healing and natural recovery gain no per-die bonus. Gain +2 on saving throws against death effects. Take 1 additional point of damage from a cold iron weapon hit, once per weapon-damage event, without multiplying this extra point on a critical hit. Cold iron weapon use is otherwise unchanged.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ExtraSpellSynthe: You can perform one additional spell synthesis per day. You can select this feat multiple times; each rank adds one daily use. Requires Mystical Mayhem Spell Synthesis. This feat does not increase PrestigePlus Lesser Spell Synthesis. Rest to refresh available uses.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.AbilityFocusCrue: The saving throw DC of your antipaladin cruelties increases by 2. Requires at least one learned cruelty. Applies to the supported MCE Touch of Corruption cruelty variants, including Channel Corruption. Other abilities are unchanged.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ImprovedTwoWeapo: Requires Dexterity 17, Intelligence 13, base attack bonus +6, Combat Expertise, Two-Weapon Fighting, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting and the native Two-Weapon Feint feat. Use the native Two-Weapon Feint mode with melee weapons: it retains its normal attack sacrifice, target restrictions and Bluff (or Slayer's Feint Mobility) check. On success, your remaining attacks against that opponent ignore its Dexterity bonus to AC until the end of your turn (six seconds in real-time). Other allies do not gain this benefit. Ordinary move-action Feint and Swordplay Upset are unchanged. Final Feint keeps its existing stronger effect.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ExtraInvestigato: Gain one additional investigator talent for which you qualify. Requires the investigator talent class feature from HomebrewArchetypes. You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a talent each time; each talent retains its own prerequisites and limits.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ReapingStalkerSl: Advanced slayer talent. Treat sickles and scythes you wield as one size larger for damage dice. Their critical threat range becomes 19-20; this uses the same native threat-range increase as Improved Critical and keen, and does not stack with them. Counts as Improved Critical (sickle) and Improved Critical (scythe) for weapon-specific feat prerequisites only; other prerequisites still apply. Requires Advanced Talents. This talent can be selected once.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.RogueAdvancedFea: Choose an ordinary feat for which you qualify in place of a rogue or slayer talent. Requires Advanced Talents. This advanced talent can be selected only once; all prerequisites and parameter choices of the chosen feat still apply. Selections that lead back to this talent (including Extra Rogue/Slayer Talent) are excluded to prevent a recursive selection menu.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.TerrifyingHowlIm: Immune to the same character's Terrifying Howl for 24 hours.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.TerrifyingHowlAb: Enemies must already be shaken: this howl does not inflict shaken by itself. While raging or accepting inspired rage, use a standard action to frighten shaken enemies within 30 feet for 1d4+1 rounds (Will negates; DC 10 + half your barbarian/skald/primalist level + your Strength modifier). A creature that attempts this save is immune to your howl for 24 hours, whether it succeeds or fails. Targets that are not shaken, cannot hear the howl because of silence, or still have this caster's 24-hour immunity do not attempt a save. Requires barbarian, skald or primalist level 8. Inspired rage grants this ability through the native sharing mechanism, like Renewed Vigor; the character using the howl is its caster.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ConversionCharmO: Use Wisdom instead of Charisma for Persuasion checks, including bluff, diplomacy and intimidation.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ConversionSwayin: At level 8, once per day as a standard action, dominate one humanoid within line of sight for 1 minute (Will negates). Caster and target must be outside silence. DC 10 + half your cleric/inquisitor level + Wisdom modifier.
Grants the associated inquisition ability and its daily uses.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ConversionInquis: Any deity. Level 1: Charm of Wisdom. Level 8: Swaying Word, once per day. Uses cleric and inquisitor levels. An inquisition replaces a domain and grants no domain spells or spell slots.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ValorTouchOfReso: As a standard action, use remove fear on one touched creature. You can use this ability 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day (minimum 1).
Grants the associated inquisition ability and its daily uses.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ValorFearless.de: At level 8, you become immune to fear.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ValorInquisition: Cayden Cailean, Erastil, Iomedae or Sarenrae. Level 1: Touch of Resolve. Level 8: immunity to fear. Uses cleric and inquisitor levels. An inquisition replaces a domain and grants no domain spells or spell slots.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PersistenceComba: Gain Combat Reflexes as a bonus feat.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PersistenceRelen: As a swift action, gain a +10-foot enhancement bonus to land speed for 1 round. Uses per day: 3 + Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).
Grants the associated inquisition ability and its daily uses.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PersistenceInner: At level 6, once per day as a swift action, heal yourself for 1d6 per two cleric/inquisitor levels and remove the chosen condition from yourself.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ArcaneCrafterMet: At wizard level 3, gain one bonus metamagic feat for which you qualify. Only registered wizard metamagic feats are offered.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ArcaneCrafterSch: A universalist school option. Metacharge replaces Hand of the Apprentice: at wizard level 3, select one bonus metamagic feat from the registered wizard bonus feats. All prerequisites still apply. The native universalist Metamagic Mastery progression at levels 8, 12, 16 and 20 is retained.

Shift replaces Acid Dart: teleport to a visible valid destination as a supernatural swift action, without provoking attacks of opportunity, 3 + Intelligence modifier times per day (minimum 1). Summoner's Charm, the conjuration specialist spell list, both opposition school choices and the native level-8 Dimensional Steps remain.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PurifyingFlamesA: Element: fire. Utility wild talent, level 4; requires kineticist level 8. Burn: 1. As a standard action, touch a creature and attempt a caster level check (1d20 + your kineticist level) against each poison's DC. A successful check neutralizes that poison, as neutralize poison. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.EnhancementSchoo: A transmutation school option. Augment replaces Telekinetic Fist; Perfection of Self replaces Change Shape at level 8. Native Physical Enhancement, the specialist spell list, both opposition-school choices and the level-20 Physical Enhancement capstone remain. Augment and Perfection of Self grant enhancement bonuses, so a larger enhancement bonus takes precedence rather than adding twice.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FlameJetHoverBuf: Permanent airborne benefits granted by Greater Flame Jet; independent of temporary flight spells.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FlameJetWildTale: Element: fire. Utility wild talent, level 3; requires kineticist level 6. Burn: 0. As a spell-like standard action, propel yourself up to 30 feet to a visible valid destination. Nearby allies do not travel with you; native mount/rider pairing remains. Greater Flame Jet changes this talent to a move action and grants the native airborne benefits. The game uses its native flat-map destination/navigation checks.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FlameJetGreaterW: Element: fire. Utility wild talent, level 5; requires kineticist level 10 and Flame Jet. Burn: 0. Flame Jet uses a move action instead of a standard action. Hover without an activation cost, using the existing flight effect: +10 feet speed, ground and difficult-terrain protection, and +3 dodge AC against grounded melee attackers while mobile and retaining Dexterity to AC. No nearby allies accompany the jet; the flying AC bonus does not stack with native wings.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FerociousBeastFe: While you are raging, your animal companion gains your rage's basic benefits, including greater rage, mighty rage and tireless rage. You spend 1 additional round of the active rage resource each round while a living animal companion benefits. This applies to personal rage, focused rage and primalist bloodrage; it does not extend inspired rage or spend raging song rounds.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.FerociousBeastGr: While you are raging, your animal companion also shares your rage powers that are constant in effect. Powers requiring an action, including stance activations, are not shared. Requires Ferocious Beast and 8 levels of barbarian or primalist. The basic Ferocious Beast cost is paid once per round.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.UndeadSchoolBase:
As a spell-like standard action, touch an undead creature. For half your wizard level in rounds (minimum 1), it gains +1 profane to attack rolls and all saving throws, increasing by +1 every five wizard levels, 1 temporary hit point per Hit Die, and +2 turn resistance against the native turn/channel abilities. Consecrate immediately dispels Bolster. Daily uses: 3 + Intelligence modifier (minimum 0).

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SuperstitionRage: While raging, gain a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities, increasing by 1 every 4 barbarian, skald or primalist levels. You cannot willingly accept the harmless spells identified by the original CotW rules: when another ally casts one on you, make its Will or Fortitude save to resist it. A successful save negates a harmless effect, or halves healing from the listed healing spells. Your own spells, spells without the harmless rule, and non-spell abilities retain their normal rules. Shared rage uses the rage source's class levels; overlapping copies do not stack.

Requires Superstition and 6 qualifying rage-power levels.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.DisruptiveRagePo: While raging, gain the native Disruptive feat: enemies in its native area take a -4 penalty on concentration checks. Its original range, targeting and concentration rules apply. Requires Superstition and 8 qualifying rage-power levels. This temporary grant does not remove an independently owned Disruptive feat.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SpellbreakerRage: While raging, enemies in your threatened area that successfully cast defensively provoke an attack of opportunity from you. This follows original CotW Spellbreaker and the game's native Counterstrike rule; failed defensive casts retain the game's ordinary behavior. Normal melee threat, attack-of-opportunity availability and immunity rules apply. Requires the Disruptive rage power and 12 qualifying rage-power levels.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ForestsBlessingD: You cast spells that appear on both the wizard and druid spell lists at +1 caster level and with +1 to their saving throw DC. The casting spellbook does not have to be a wizard spellbook. Select through Arcane Discovery. Requires wizard level 5 or arcanist level 10; these class levels are not added together.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ResilientIllusio: When a creature attempts to disbelieve your illusion, roll 1d20 + the illusion's caster level. Its save DC is the higher of its current DC and that result. Applies to native shadow disbelief and the Will disbelief saves of Phantasmal Killer, Weird, Phantasmal Web and Phantasmal Putrefaction; their Fortitude saves and other illusion saves are unchanged. Select through Arcane Discovery. Requires wizard level 8 or arcanist level 16; these class levels are not added together.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.BardicMasterpiec: Learn one original CotW bardic masterpiece. Each masterpiece has its own Bard or Skald class-level requirement and uses your existing bardic performance or raging song rounds. It grants no performance resource. A Bard/Skald multiclass character can choose which existing pool to spend. The masterpieces share the native Bardic Performance group, including its normal exclusivity and Lingering Performance rules.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.ClamorOfHeavensM: As a standard action, perform a 30-foot audible masterpiece affecting evil creatures, including evil allies. Each affected creature makes a Will save (DC 10 + half your combined Bard and Skald levels + your Charisma modifier). Evil undead and outsiders are stunned on failure or staggered on success; other evil creatures are blinded on failure or shaken on success. Effects last while the creature hears this performance. This follows original CotW's implemented effects: Wrath has no deafened condition. Normal condition immunities apply. Staggered, blinded and shaken also respect their usual specific-effect immunities. Stun follows original CotW's special rules for this performance. Starting costs 3 performance rounds; each additional round costs 1.

A pillar of sunlight fills a 30-foot radius and fascinates enemies as the native bardic Fascinate performance, using your Skald level and Charisma. A successful Will save or damage grants the native 24-hour immunity. Damage, leaving the area and stopping the performance end its effect. Only one bardic performance can be maintained.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.SunsingerArchety: A Skald devoted to Sarenrae. Gains Channel Solar Energy at level 5 and Pillar of Light at level 6. Requires a good or true-neutral alignment and Sarenrae. Replaces Spell Kenning at level 5 and its extra uses at levels 11 and 17 whenever these native features are supplied, including TabletopTweaks. Vanilla Wrath grants neither those features nor Song of Marching; no unrelated Rage Power, Versatile Performance or spellcasting feature is removed.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.UrbanSkaldProfic: Retain native Skald weapon, light armor and shield proficiency and armored casting, but not medium armor proficiency or medium-armored casting.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.UrbanSkaldNoCast: Accepting allies can cast normally; no AC penalty.

Affected enemies take -2 AC and attack and must pass concentration checks to cast (DC 15 + spell level). The effect ends when the enemy leaves or the song ends. strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.UrbanSkaldArchet: A city-trained Skald with controlled inspired rage, Back of the Crowd and Infuriating Mockery. Replaces medium armor proficiency, Inspired Rage, Dirge of Doom and Skald damage reduction. Wrath has no Song of Marching to remove; all other native features and spellcasting remain unchanged.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.RogueSwashbuckle: At Rogue level 1, gain proficiency with all martial weapons. You may take Combat Trick twice. When an upstream mod restricts the native talent to once, a second Combat Trick becomes available after your first; Wrath's unrestricted repeatable native talent otherwise remains unchanged.
At Rogue level 3, gain a +1 morale bonus on Mobility checks and saving throws against fear. The bonus increases by 1 at levels 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18, to a maximum of +6.
Requires Martial Training and the original Combat Trick. Gain one additional combat feat, satisfying its normal prerequisites. This additional talent can be selected once.

A Rogue archetype focused on martial training and daring acrobatics. Martial Training replaces Trapfinding at level 1 and permits a second Combat Trick when an upstream mod makes the native talent once-only. Daring replaces Danger Sense at levels 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18. Wrath's unrestricted Combat Trick and all unrelated talents, sneak attack and class features are retained. This is a Rogue archetype, separate from any standalone Swashbuckler class.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HedgeWitchSponta: Convert a prepared witch spell of level 1 or higher into a cure spell without knowing or preparing that cure. Uses the original CotW witch conversion table: Light 1, Moderate 2/3, Serious 4, Critical 5, Mass Light 6, Mass Moderate 7, Mass Serious 8, Mass Critical 9. Cantrips cannot be converted. The converted spell consumes its original prepared slot; no separate daily resource.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HedgeWitchEmpath: At witch level 8, gain a +3 bonus on Lore (Religion) checks. This is the original CotW skill-bonus implementation.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.HedgeWitchArchet: A hedge witch devotes herself to healing. Spontaneous Healing at level 1 converts prepared witch spells into cure spells without learning or preparing them. Empathic Healing at level 8 grants +3 to Lore (Religion), following the original CotW implementation. Replaces only the hex choices at levels 4 and 8; retains the familiar, patron, prepared spellbook, spell progression and other hexes.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.TerrorWeaverArch: A number of exceptional tribesmen have developed potent psychic abilities, unlocked by generations of exposure to a specific combination of mind-altering fungi and radiation. Powerful manipulators, they often rule smaller tribes from the shadows, but with only few able to match their mental acuity, their only limit is their own ambition.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PrimalBloodlineS:
Each sorcerer has a source of magic somewhere in her heritage that grants her spells, bonus feats, an additional class skill, and other special abilities. This source can represent a blood relation or an extreme event involving a creature somewhere in the family's past. For example, a sorcerer might have a dragon as a distant relative or her grandfather might have signed a terrible contract with a devil. Regardless of the source, this influence manifests in a number of ways as the sorcerer gains levels. A sorcerer must pick one bloodline upon taking her first level of sorcerer. Once made, this choice cannot be changed.
Filled with magical power that screams for release, sorcery is not so much a calling as a blessing — or a curse. For some sorcerers, this arcane birthright manifests in subtle and carefully controlled ways, assisting in their manipulation of others or the pursuit of lofty goals. For others, it is wild and unpredictable, the primal and explosive lashing out of a power greater than themselves.
At 3rd level, and every two levels thereafter, a sorcerer learns an additional spell, derived from her bloodline. These spells are in addition to the number of spells given at new levels. These spells cannot be exchanged for different spells at higher levels.
At 7th level, and every six levels thereafter, a sorcerer receives one bonus feat, chosen from a list specific to each bloodline. The sorcerer must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats.
strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.PrimalSorcererAr: Your powers are attuned to the concentrated core of the elemental plane.
At 3rd level, a rake gains a +1 morale bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks. This bonus increases by +1 for every 3 levels beyond 3rd.

strings.cotw-wrath.psychic.full.RakeArchetype014: The rake is a rogue who is open about her skills and talents, often to the point of being boastful. Usually she has the protection of an important figure who finds her services useful, but sometimes her bravado is enough to keep enemies away. She is often used as a face for the group for diplomacy, gathering information, negotiations, or to gain the most lucrative contracts and quests from local authorities.
